{"script": "cd /home/user && python3 << 'EOF'
import FreeCAD
import Part
import Path
import PathGui

# Open the precondition file
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd")
FreeCAD.ActiveDocument = doc

# Get the final shape from Chamfer object
chamfer = doc.getObject("Chamfer")
box = doc.getObject("Box")
body = doc.getObject("Body")

FreeCAD.ActiveDocument.recompute()

# Create a Stock block that fully contains the target shape
# The part is 50x30x12, so we'll make stock slightly larger (e.g., 60x40x20)
stock_length = 60.0
stock_width = 40.0
stock_height = 20.0

# Center the stock around the part (part is at 0,0,0 to 50,30,12)
# Stock will be centered at (25, 15, 6) but extend beyond
stock_placement = FreeCAD.Placement(
    FreeCAD.Vector((60-50)/2 - 0, (40-30)/2 - 0, (20-12)/2 - 0),  # Position to center
    FreeCAD.Rotation()
)

# Create a box for stock using PartDesign
from PartDesign import AdditiveBox

# First, we need to add the stock to the body or as a separate object
# Let's create it as a separate Part::Feature in the document
stock_shape = Part.makeBox(stock_length, stock_width, stock_height)
stock_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Stock")
stock_obj.Shape = stock_shape
stock_obj.Placement = stock_placement

print(f"Created Stock object: {stock_obj.Name}")
print(f"Stock dimensions: {stock_length} x {stock_width} x {stock_height}")

# Now set up the Path workbench
# Create a Job
job = Path.Group.createJob(doc, "Job")
job.Name = "ChamferJob"
job.Label = "Chamfer Job"

# Set the model (the part to machine)
job.Model = [chamfer]

# Set the stock
job.Stock = stock_obj

# Create a Setup
setup = job.addSetup()
setup.Name = "Setup1"
setup.Label = "Chamfer Setup"

# Create a tool for chamfering (use an end mill or chamfer mill)
tool_controller = Path.ToolController()
tool_controller.Name = "Tool1"
tool_controller.Label = "Chamfer Tool"

# Set tool parameters - use a 6mm end mill for general purpose
tool_controller.ToolNumber = 1
tool_controller.ToolDiameter = 6.0
tool_controller.ToolLength = 50.0
tool_controller.FeedRate = 100.0
tool_controller.PlungeRate = 50.0

# Create the chamfer path operation
# For chamfering edges, we can use a Profile operation or Edge-based operation
path_op = Path.Path("Profile")
path_op.Name = "ChamferProfile"
path_op.Label = "Chamfer Profile"

# Get the edges to chamfer from the original chamfer feature
base_edges = chamfer.Base[1]  # This should give us the edge list
print(f"Edges to chamfer: {base_edges}")

# Set the path geometry
path_op.Geometry = [chamfer]

# Add to the setup
setup.addPath(path_op)

# Link tool controller to the path
path_op.ToolController = tool_controller

# Recompute
FreeCAD.ActiveDocument.recompute()

print("\nCAM setup created successfully!")
print(f"Job: {job.Name}")
print(f"Setup: {setup.Name}")
print(f"Tool: {tool_controller.Name}")
print(f"Path: {path_op.Name}")

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print(f"\nSaved to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
EOF"}
